card.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
card.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. I put it in the right drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Filed, then. I'll reconcile it against this quote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Estimate filed; purchase order requested. I'm getting fluent in accounts already.

mechanism: A performs membership in accounts by confidently using and revising terminology as a colleague explains it.
confusable: Unlike simply learning openly, A must maintain a claim of fluency while each correction supplies the next term.
comparison: Invoice terminology is adjusted through filing and purchase orders; club procedure uses motions and unanimity.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
